extras.name: HWiNFO
extras.why: Optional. No mod needs it now: the taskbar reads its own sensors. Install it if you want its full sensor window. Always the newest beta, starts with Windows.

extras.name: PawnIO
extras.why: Processor temperature, power and clocks come from this small signed driver. Without it those show a dash.

extras.name: Everything
extras.why: Explorer search and folder sizes come from it. The newest beta, set up the way DavidHiFi has it.

extras.name: Logitech G HUB
extras.why: Optional. The battery tray reads most Logitech mice and headsets without it. Only goes in when you ask for it.

extras.name: Seamless download engine
extras.why: The download manager does its downloading with it. Small, runs inside the mod, no admin rights.

extras.name: Mocha Steam
extras.why: DavidHiFi's look for Steam, with his plugins. Steam closes for a moment while it goes in.

extras.name: FreeDictate
extras.why: Type with your voice in any app. It runs on your PC, nothing goes online.

extras.name: Seamless Music Player
extras.why: DavidHiFi's light music player for Windows, with lyrics, Soulseek and YouTube search built in.

extras.name: PresentMon
extras.why: The overlay uses it to measure how long a frame takes to appear on screen.
